scripts.content: node scripts/ensure-source.mjs && node scripts/build-content.mjs ../vendor/javascript-algorithms/src && node scripts/build-docs.mjs && node scripts/build-ai.mjs && node scripts/build-sd.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run verify && : "${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:?set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID so this cannot deploy to the wrong Cloudflare account}" && wrangler pages deploy out --project-name dev-essentials --branch main
scripts.verify: npm run content && node scripts/verify.mjs && node scripts/check-ui.mjs && node scripts/lint-lessons.mjs ai --strict > /dev/null && node scripts/lint-lessons.mjs sd --strict > /dev/null && next build
